problem: Native square low-progress timeout with safety-qualified first-action rescue, raw-ranking residual, good action not blocked, and raw top equals final top. Same-support true one-step query does not select a successful command. No temporal claim or unique training-cause claim.
selection: Parent-only fresh low-progress-timeout records. Round-robin populations5 then10, ascending case IDs, skip case IDs already selected across populations; lowest failed seed per case. At most4 distinct cases. Freeze all4 roots before new action outcomes.
root: Low-progress: start of first qualifying interval. Other failures: first t>=2s legal clearance<=0.8m within final10s; otherwise beginning of final10s. One root per episode.
headroom: All80 already-smoothed root commands once for0.25s, then same corrected checkpoint policy with lawful sensing until termination. No second smoothing. Q^pi, not Q*. Full native-return and command baseline replay parity required.
safety: Keep every actual clearance. Successful branches below0.02m are flagged fragile, not counted as safety-qualified rescues;0.02m is a diagnostic screen, not a new reward.
attribution: Raw-top success with final-top failure: postprocessing. Otherwise true-one-step same-actor-support query selecting a successful action: successor/query interface. Otherwise successful action raw rank>=10: value-ranking residual. No successful first command: no-single-step-rescue; other patterns unresolved. These localize a consumer stage, not training/representation/temporal causation.
pass_rule: At least2 distinct fresh case IDs satisfy the unchanged value-ranking-residual classification, with good not blocked and raw_top==final_top. Report training-seed scope separately. Otherwise this pooled candidate stops; no redefinition or extra cases.
